OneLineDescription: Patcher to reset map markers of custom type to predefined vanilla type
LongDescription:
The Beyond Skyrim mod projects use an implementation of custom map markers that edits a vanilla Skyrim interface files and is thus incompatible with Skyrim VR and mods that use also edit this file.

 This patcher resets all custom map markers to a vanilla one according to a config file that is included in the patcher. 
 This config file can be replaced by a custom csv file of the same structure. 
 The patcher also contains the option to generate parts of a CoMAP conifg file for the mod by Jelidity. However this is disabled by default and is only intended for mod authors.
